title: Experience helps differences combine
meaning: Practical combination of different actions through understood experience is emotionally expressed in a gradual sense of different needs fitting together.
text: Combining actions and feeling their combination are different aspects of shared experience. Temperance in the physical position of this Energy Field describes practice where you recognise different needs and adjust the relationship between contributions. In emotions, the same Temperance brings an experience of differences gradually coming together. The Hermit in energy motivates drawing on understood experience and sharing what has become clear. The overall tone can be thoughtful: you act differently for something shared and gradually feel those approaches finding room beside each other.

For example, you organise shared reading so that one person reads beforehand while the other encounters a short passage during the meeting. Earlier attempts showed that an identical quota obstructed living conversation. Practical differences now combine, while emotional relief takes time. **Our actions already fit together, and the feeling of comfortable coexistence is still developing.** Satisfaction requires neither an immediate forgetting of earlier tiredness nor an identical assessment of the new format. A useful practice can precede the feeling of being settled within it.

A difficulty arises if a workable arrangement is declared proof of finished harmony. One person is still adapting while the other already expects complete calm. Understood experience becomes an explanation for both people, and combination loses flexibility. Temperance’s two roles require neither doubled patience nor permanent compromise. The Hermit makes no past conclusion final: new circumstances can alter both the practical relationship between contributions and how each person emotionally experiences it.
